text.en:
of No. S 44

CHINESE MARRIAGE ENACTMENT, 1955 In exercise of the powers conferred on him by section 3 (1) of the Chinese Marriage Enactment, No.6 of 1955. 1955, the Deputy Sultan has been pleased to appoint Mr. Teo Eng Teck to be a Registrar of Chinese Marriages for the Temburong District in place of 1\fr. Lau Cheng Kau By COMMAND,

MARSAL MAUN Mentri Besar, Brunei. Dated this 22nd February, 1966. [Ref.: SDK. 646/54]
